# Bento Grid

Asymmetric grid of feature tiles (normal, wide, tall or large) with icon, title, description, optional background image and a call-to-action that slides in on hover. Good for home pages and app launchpads.

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_BENTO_GRID` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/bentoGrid` |
| Modes | report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Based on | [Magic UI](https://magicui.design/docs/components/bento-grid) (MIT) |

Each row is one tile. Map Span to a column returning normal, wide, tall or large to build the bento layout. On phones all tiles stack in one column.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | Title | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Tile heading. |
| `description` | Description | sessionStateValue |  |  | One or two sentences under the title. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Font APEX icon class, for example fa-line-chart. |
| `linkUrl` | Link URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Target of the tile (developer-controlled URL, for example apex_page.get_url(p_page => 10)). |
| `linkLabel` | Link Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Call-to-action text, for example Open. Shown on hover or focus (always on touch screens). |
| `span` | Span | sessionStateValue |  |  | Tile size: normal (1x1), wide (2x1), tall (1x2) or large (2x2). Unknown values render as normal. |
| `imageUrl` | Background Image URL | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional decorative image shown faded at the top of the tile. |
| `rowHeight` | Row Height | selectList (`compact`, `tall`) |  |  | Height of one grid row. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/bento-grid/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_bento_grid.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
